item.title: In 2018, Massachusetts removed the first of two old dams from former cranberry bogs; by 2020...
item.description: In a groundbreaking ecological revival, old dams on the Coonamessett River in Massachusetts were dismantled, restoring wetlands and providing passage for migratory fish. This project repurposed industrial farmland into a flourishing coastal ecosystem, allowing fish to ascend to upstream spawning spots that had been blocked for years. The restoration involved creating a sinuous stream channel and replacing a narrow culvert, establishing a model for agricultural bog transformations throughout New England.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Meet Samuel Henderson, the 12-year-old who can mimic more than 100 bird calls and is now...
item.description: Samuel Henderson, a gifted young boy, has skyrocketed to social media fame with his extraordinary ability to mimic over one hundred bird species solely using his voice. His captivating talent has enchanted audiences worldwide, accumulating millions of views. Remarkably, wild birds often respond to his lifelike calls. Samuel now passionately advocates for wildlife conservation and encourages everyone to explore the great outdoors.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Airbnb is committing $250 million to help stalled US housing projects get built
item.description: Airbnb has announced a robust initiative to inject $250 million into stalled housing projects, targeting funding shortfalls in construction-ready developments. The first investment of $6.4 million is earmarked for creating affordable housing in Austin, Texas. Additionally, a $5 million innovation prize will encourage advancements in housing technology, all part of Airbnb's commitment to tackling the persistent housing crisis in the United States.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: In 2020, a San Diego mom and her toddler began cooking extra meals for struggling neighbours
item.description: Supermodel Gisele Bündchen has recently made headlines with her acquisition of a stunning 7.5-acre equestrian estate for $9.1 million. This property boasts ten horse stalls and a full-sized soccer field, making it an ideal haven for both sports and equestrian pursuits. With this addition, her Florida real estate portfolio expands further, offering a peaceful retreat that beautifully complements her existing waterfront homes.

item.title: Inside Chris Pratt’s 100-acre Washington ranch with sheep, pigs and award-winning wool
item.description: Chris Pratt’s 100-acre Stillwater Ranch in Washington’s San Juan Islands offers the Hollywood star a peaceful escape from his hectic career. Home to sheep, pigs and other animals, the farm has become a place where Pratt embraces nature and a slower rhythm. He says farming helps clear his mind and benefits the human mind and soul.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Meet Aditya Sengupta, the 18-year-old Bellevue student who built an AI system to...
item.description: An impressive feat for an 18-year-old student, ForeCAT is a groundbreaking AI model he created to predict hazardous clear-air turbulence. Garnering a prestigious scholarship from the Davidson Institute, this innovative system merges atmospheric physics with computational power, achieving remarkable accuracy that surpasses conventional turbulence forecasting techniques. By improving flight safety and minimizing airline interruptions, ForeCAT holds promising implications for the aviation industry.

item.title: TikTok reviewer’s viral Anime NYC visit gives indie creator 25,000 followers, sells out his comics
item.description: A TikTok comic reviewer’s visit to an overlooked booth at Anime NYC gave indie creator Dare a major boost. His video about Dare’s Yoruba-inspired comics, “Ori: Holder of the Heads” and “Etch”, received one million likes. The viral post brought about 25,000 new followers to Dare’s account and helped him sell out his available comic copies almost overnight.

item.title: New York covered 5 acres of Lake George with 700 mats; 97% clams died, but later spread to 27 sites
item.description: In 2011, Lake George took significant action against its invasive Asian clam issue by implementing a large-scale benthic barrier treatment, which successfully eliminated ninety-seven percent of clams in a five-acre area. However, by 2019, these clams made a comeback, with twenty-seven sites identified. Consequently, efforts have shifted to monitoring their spread and impact on the ecosystem.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Pittsburgh’s former steel mill site is transforming into hub for robotics, biotech, housing & parks
item.description: After decades of lying vacant, Pittsburgh’s former steel mill site Hazelwood Green is finally seeing major redevelopment. Since 2022, around 700,000 square feet has been developed or is under construction, including Carnegie Mellon’s robotics centre, Pitt’s BioForge facility, housing, parks and a football field. More technology, retail and housing projects are planned across the 178-acre riverfront site.

item.title: Canada will be ‘stronger, more resilient, more independent’ after US trade war: Carney
item.description: Canada aims for economic resilience and independence from trade disputes. New tax incentives will encourage private investment in Canadian businesses. The nation is also seeking deeper economic ties with the European Union. This strategy aims to reduce dependence on the United States market. Canada remains open to future mutually beneficial agreements with Washington.

item.title: At 22, Jayden Williams became Stockbridge’s youngest mayor; 10 months later, the city council...
item.description: In a surprising turn of events, Stockbridge's youngest mayor, Jayden Williams, was ousted following a misconduct hearing. The city council uncovered serious concerns surrounding his management of resources and city property. Facing claims of financial impropriety, Williams defended himself by pointing to insufficient training. Now, Stockbridge is preparing for a special election to choose a new mayor to bridge the leadership gap.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Our father being slowly killed': Imran Khan's sons accuse Asim Munir of vendetta
item.description: Imran Khan's sons publicly claim that army chief Asim Munir is engaging in a personal vendetta against their father. They voice serious concerns over Khan's prison conditions, labeling them as torture. For more than six months, the sons have been unable to contact their father, and they worry about his neglected eye condition, which could lead to significant vision impairment. However, the Pakistani government dismisses these allegations as unfounded propaganda.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: Inside Gisele Bündchen’s $9.1 million, 7.5-acre Florida ranch with 10 horse stalls, an equestrian ring
item.description: Supermodel Gisele Bündchen has made a stunning investment in Florida, acquiring a vast 7.5-acre equestrian estate priced at $9.1 million. This impressive property includes ten horse stalls and even a full-sized soccer field, catering to her passion for horses and outdoor activities. With nine bedrooms and significant renovations complete, this estate adds to her expanding real estate portfolio, perfect for luxurious living amidst nature.

item.title: Western Australia created two reefs with 60 concrete boxes; fish species rose from 12 to more than 60
item.description: Launched in 2013, purpose-designed artificial reefs were deployed along Western Australia's coast, leading to a remarkable transformation of the seafloor. In a span of three years, fish species surged from a mere dozen to an impressive sixty. These artificial structures not only enrich marine biodiversity but also provide excellent recreational fishing sites, exemplifying the project's effectiveness in promoting both marine life and community involvement.
